ownerPolicy: One explicit arm only; native original0af600, matchedNode original0af300; no loop/retry. Root1GiB start and genuine fullnative/world guards remain separate.

transportProfile.framing: One ordinaryHTTP200; unambiguous chunked(no extensions), exactContentLength, or actual-peer-end close-delimited. Other profiles fail/inconclusive.
transportProfile.gzip: One DEFLATE gzip member only; normal finish, consumed-input boundary, ownCRC32 and finalISIZE. Concatenation/trailing/padding/unknown refused.
transportProfile.decoded: Opaque complete Flight bytes; no React/RSC/JSON interpretation. Native inflate failures may yield no decoded prefix; no synthetic bytes.
transportProfile.rawSocketScope: Received data through HTTP message terminal plus current-event listener completion; not all future keepalive traffic. Client Agent destruction is explicit cleanup, never peerEOF.
transportProfile.cleanup: After durable raw/encoded prefixes and validation attempt; accepted only if actual message end and private Agent socket close observed.
